# `toolu opencode`

Run toolu plugins under OpenCode; their generated server.js calls these.

Owner: `plugins/toolu`.

## `toolu opencode`

```text
Run toolu plugins under OpenCode; their generated server.js calls these

Usage: toolu opencode [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  bridge   Run a plugin's hooks for one OpenCode hook call read from stdin
  catalog  Print a plugin's skills and commands as OpenCode registers them
  help     Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --json              Print exactly one JSON document on stdout
  -q, --quiet             Drop the diagnostics of a successful run
      --host <HOST>       The host to act for, instead of the detected one [possible values: claude, codex, cursor, hermes, muse, opencode]
      --config-dir <DIR>  Read the toolu config from DIR instead of the host's default
  -h, --help              Print help
```

## `toolu opencode bridge`

```text
Run a plugin's hooks for one OpenCode hook call read from stdin

Usage: toolu opencode bridge [OPTIONS] --event <HOOK> --plugin-root <DIR>

Options:
      --event <HOOK>       The OpenCode hook the call came from [possible values: session.start, session.prompt, session.compaction, tool.execute.before, tool.execute.after]
      --json               Print exactly one JSON document on stdout
      --plugin-root <DIR>  The plugin directory: the shim's own
  -q, --quiet              Drop the diagnostics of a successful run
      --host <HOST>        The host to act for, instead of the detected one [possible values: claude, codex, cursor, hermes, muse, opencode]
      --config-dir <DIR>   Read the toolu config from DIR instead of the host's default
  -h, --help               Print help
```

## `toolu opencode catalog`

```text

Options:
      --json               Print exactly one JSON document on stdout
      --plugin-root <DIR>  The plugin directory: the shim's own
  -q, --quiet              Drop the diagnostics of a successful run
      --host <HOST>        The host to act for, instead of the detected one [possible values: claude, codex, cursor, hermes, muse, opencode]
      --config-dir <DIR>   Read the toolu config from DIR instead of the host's default
  -h, --help               Print help
```
